home.subtitle: New rounds open every hour. Settlement is decided solely by the first signed Chainlink OCR2 report after expiry — no intermediary decides the outcome. A market can be opened with just over 1 USDT.
home.why1: Open a market with just over 1 USDT. No one's approval needed.
home.why2: Settlement is verified on-chain from the first Chainlink OCR2 report after expiry — proven adjacent or snapshot-certified, regardless of who submits it.
home.why3: Exposure is released gradually as expiry approaches and can be claimed at any time. Every fee is collected in the pool; distribution to the makers present opens in a later phase.
home.nextBody: Rounds open on the hour. The question is set by the price at the open.

help.title: Veritas: a fast, permissionless prediction market
help.sub: Hourly markets on crypto prices. Anyone can open one, anyone can trade — and settlement needs no one's permission: the first Chainlink OCR2 report after expiry decides.
help.v1Title: Open a market with just over 1 USDT
help.v1: No listing review, no gatekeeper. Seed a market with a little over 1 USDT of collateral and it is live.
help.v2: Which side redeems is decided by the first signed Chainlink OCR2 report after expiry — verified directly on-chain, not by a person you have to trust.
help.v3Title: Every fee stays in the pool
help.v3: Every trade pays 0.3% on the way in and 0.3% on the way out. The protocol takes none of it — all of it is collected in the pool, marked for the makers who were present when it accrued. Distribution opens in a later phase.
help.risk: Making markets is not free money. When the price moves, better-informed traders trade against you first — that adverse-selection loss (LVR) is the real cost of providing liquidity, and fees only partly offset it. Veritas shrinks the risk rather than erasing it: a maker's exposure winds down automatically as expiry approaches. And the settlement rules have hard edges: if the first report after expiry lands more than 10 seconds late, or nobody settles within 48 hours of expiry, the market is voided and every token redeems at 0.5 USDT — nobody gets paid out on a stale price.
help.d1: Prices on this site are read directly from Chainlink Store Transmissions accounts on-chain — the same oracle feeds that settle the markets. The small age next to each price is the age of that print itself.
help.d2: Settlement verifies two signed Chainlink OCR2 reports straddling expiry: the pre-expiry report and the first post-expiry report, checked on-chain against the feed's oracle roster, config digest, and round adjacency (or an expiry snapshot).
help.d3: Charts use Coinbase candles for reference only. They are never used for settlement.
help.d4: This deployment runs on Solana devnet. On devnet, Chainlink prints may pause or skip rounds occasionally — the age label next to every price shows exact print freshness.
help.deepWhyLabel: Why we built it this way
help.a0Title: 01 · Low threshold: Built for high-frequency fast markets
help.a0: Veritas is built around 15-minute and 1-hour fast markets. Short-horizon price swings move fast, and traders want to spin up a market the moment they spot a setup; if opening a 15-minute market required heavy market-making capital or a listing committee, fast markets would never get off the ground. A market that resolves in minutes should not demand heavy upfront capital from its creator.
help.a0Sub: We lowered market creation to just over 1 USDT (1,000,001 micro-units) with zero manual approval. On creation, the contract calibrates initial depth from the seed deposit and duration T via L₀ = budget / (φ(0)·√T) at 50:50, binds a whitelisted Chainlink OCR2 state account, and initializes the MarketSnapshot PDA. Under the hood, every 1 USDT mints 1 YES + 1 NO (mergeable 1:1 back to 1 USDT via merge_token at any time while open), making fast-market creation effortless while guaranteeing 100% collateralization by construction.
help.a1Title: 03 · Liquidity that stays to settlement: pm-AMM (L_eff = L₀√(T−t))
help.a1: As a fast market approaches expiry, the outcome becomes clearer. If a traditional constant-product pool (x·y=k) locks liquidity statically in the pool, LPs get bled dry by arbitrageurs (LVR adverse selection) in the final minutes — forcing makers to pull liquidity early right when traders need depth the most.
help.a1Sub: We implement Paradigm's pm-AMM Gaussian invariant (P = Φ((y − x) / L_eff)), decaying effective liquidity L_eff = L₀·√(T − t) smoothly with the square root of time remaining. Before every trade, LP action, or settlement, compute_accrual scales active reserves to the new L_eff at constant price P and credits the released YES/NO inventory pro-rata to LPs (withdrawable and mergeable back to USDT at any time) — winding down maker risk automatically while keeping calibrated depth right up to expiry.
help.a2Title: 02 · No dispute period: Second-level finality & 3-tier settlement defense
help.a2: In a 15-minute fast market, waiting hours for a committee vote or dispute window ruins the product. Eliminating the dispute period so anyone can settle with a single click requires one guarantee: the contract itself must verify on-chain that a print is the first valid price after expiry, without jamming on network hiccups.
help.a2Sub: Chainlink OCR2 updates roughly every 3 seconds on Solana; across 2,384 consecutive on-chain store transitions tested across all 6 feeds (including 1,786 full-coverage adjacent pairs), we observed zero skipped rounds. On top of that baseline, we built a 3-tier on-chain defense:
help.a2Tier1: Tier 1 (Normal path · Straddling adjacent-round squeeze): Anyone can click settle and submit the two signed OCR2 reports straddling expiry T (pre < T ≤ post). The contract verifies secp256k1 oracle multi-signatures and round adjacency on-chain (round + 1, or round 6 rolling into round 1 of the next epoch), locking in the first post-expiry price and preventing cherry-picking.
help.a2Tier2: Tier 2 (Fault recovery · Failed-tx extraction + Keeper counter backstop): Even if an oracle transmit transaction failed on-chain, its signed OCR2 report payload remains cryptographically valid and is still extracted for settlement. If an extreme round skip ever leaves no transaction on-chain at all, the ±10s keeper script's monotonic on-chain snapshot counter (counter + 1 via take_snapshot) certifies continuity between the two reports.
help.a2Tier3: Tier 3 (Ultimate backstop · On-chain 0.5 refund + Protocol reimbursement): Only when an unrecorded oracle round skip coincides with a keeper script outage (or the feed halts for >10s / nobody settles within 48h) does the fallback trigger — the contract refuses to settle on a stale price, voids the market so both YES and NO redeem at 0.5 USDT, and the protocol team covers any extreme anomaly with a full reimbursement backstop.
help.a2Fallback: Even if the protocol team did nothing at all, anyone can still settle any expired market within the 48-hour window — either by clicking "Settle now" directly on the market page (where your browser extracts the OCR2 signatures straight from the RPC with zero backend dependency) or by running the open-source settlement script to invoke resolve_market:
help.footnote: Veritas currently runs on Solana Devnet — a demo environment, and no real funds are involved.
help.quickTitle: New here? Start in three steps
help.q1: Use Phantom or any Solana wallet and switch its network to Devnet — Veritas runs on the test network, so nothing here touches real funds.
help.q2: Once connected, click "Faucet" next to the wallet button in the top-right header to claim 100 test USDT (once a day) and free Devnet SOL for transaction fees.
help.q2Cooldown: Already claimed today — come back tomorrow
help.q3: Open any live market, pick YES or NO, and confirm. Your position shows up under Me, and after settlement you redeem at 1:1 on the same market page.
help.ex1: Target 60,000; the first report after expiry reads 60,120 — above the target, so YES redeems 1:1 and NO expires worthless.
help.ex2: Same target, but the first report lands 12 seconds after expiry — too stale to trust, so the market is voided instead and every token redeems at 0.5 USDT.
